# Gawri Ganga

> Nepali Rudraksha, Rudraksha bracelets, original Tulsi malas, Karungali (ebony wood) malas, and smoke-free aura sprays. Shipped from Noida across India. Gawri Ganga is owned by BNB Basket and Boxes Gifting Solutions Private Limited. GST 09AAFCE9670A1ZL.

Traditional reasons to wear these pieces are for japa, daily practice, and a sense of protection. They are not medicines, and the site does not claim lab certificates that are not shown on the product page. Prices and stock come from the live product pages.

## Collections

- [Nepali Rudraksha](https://www.gawriganga.com/rudraksha): Beads, japa malas, and mukhi counts for daily wear.
- [Rudraksha bracelets and Karungali malas](https://www.gawriganga.com/accessories): Wrist bracelets and ebony wood malas.
- [Tulsi malas](https://www.gawriganga.com/tulsimala): Holy basil wood malas for naam jap. Rama and Shyam describe colour, not a certificate.
- [Aura sprays](https://www.gawriganga.com/sprays): Amrat Bindu, Maitri, Chakra Balance, and Shuddhi. Spray the air, not the beads.
- [Rudraksha by rashi](https://www.gawriganga.com/rashi): A traditional mukhi match for a zodiac sign.
- [Gift sets](https://www.gawriganga.com/combos): Combos for home use, festivals, and weddings.
- [Bulk and corporate gifting](https://www.gawriganga.com/corporate-bulk-orders): Quote form for larger orders.

## Why these are worn

- [Importance of wearing Rudraksha](https://www.gawriganga.com/guides/importance-of-wearing-rudraksha): Japa, mukhi counts, and how to start.
- [Why wear a Rudraksha bracelet](https://www.gawriganga.com/guides/why-wear-a-rudraksha-bracelet): Daily wrist wear versus a 108-bead mala.
- [Why people wear a Karungali mala](https://www.gawriganga.com/guides/benefits-of-wearing-karungali-mala): Ebony wood, who wears it, and dry care.
- [Importance of a Tulsi mala](https://www.gawriganga.com/guides/importance-of-tulsi-mala): Japa, Rama and Shyam beads, and wood care.
- [Why Rudraksha, Karungali, Tulsi, and aura sprays matter](https://www.gawriganga.com/guides/why-rudraksha-karungali-and-tulsi-matter): What each product is for.
